description: This file implements the statistics management for the Battle for Wesnoth game, including data structures, serialization, and functions for recording and merging game statistics related to scenarios, units, and battles.

classes.name: scenario_stats
classes.description: Holds statistics for a specific scenario, including team stats and scenario name.

classes.name: stats
classes.description: Contains various game statistics such as recruits, kills, attacks, and damage metrics.

classes.name: disabler
classes.description: Manages enabling/disabling statistics collection via constructor/destructor.

classes.name: scenario_context
classes.description: Context manager for scenario statistics, manages scenario lifecycle.

classes.name: attack_context
classes.description: Records details of an attack or defense between units, updates stats accordingly.

methods.name: scenario_stats::scenario_stats
methods.description: Constructor initializing scenario stats from a config.

methods.name: scenario_stats::write
methods.description: Serializes scenario stats to a config object.

methods.name: stats::stats
methods.description: Default constructor initializing stats to zero.

methods.name: stats::stats
methods.description: Constructor initializing stats from a config object.

methods.name: stats::write
methods.description: Serializes stats to a config object.

methods.name: stats::read
methods.description: Deserializes stats from a config object.

methods.name: attack_context::attack_context
methods.description: Constructor setting attacker and defender info.

methods.name: attack_context::~attack_context
methods.description: Destructor updating attack stats.

methods.name: attack_context::attack_result
methods.description: Records attack outcome, updates stats.

methods.name: attack_context::defend_result
methods.description: Records defend outcome, updates stats.

methods.name: recruit_unit
methods.description: Records a unit recruitment in stats.

methods.name: recall_unit
methods.description: Records a unit recall in stats.

methods.name: un_recall_unit
methods.description: Removes a recalled unit from stats.

methods.name: advance_unit
methods.description: Records a unit advancement in stats.

methods.name: calculate_stats
methods.description: Calculates and returns stats for a given category and side.

methods.name: write_stats
methods.description: Serializes all stats to a config object.

methods.name: read_stats
methods.description: Deserializes stats from a config object.

methods.name: fresh_stats
methods.description: Clears all current stats.

methods.name: clear_current_scenario
methods.description: Removes the last scenario's stats from master list.

methods.name: get_categories
methods.description: Returns list of scenario categories for stats.

methods.name: sum_str_int_map
methods.description: Sums all values in a str_int_map.
